name: knob
description: Potentiometer (rotary knob) driver via ADC. Reads raw value, percentage, or mapped value in user-defined range. Defaults to 12-bit ADC (0-4095).

constructor_params.name: adc_bits
constructor_params.description: ADC resolution bits (12 → max ADC value 4095)

properties.name: percent
properties.description: Current value as 0.0-100.0 percentage (1 decimal place)

example:
from machine import Pin
from knob import Knob
from time import sleep_ms

knob = Knob(pin=Pin(34), min_val=0, max_val=100)
while True:
    print(knob.percent, knob.value_int)
    sleep_ms(100)
esp32_notes: ADC attenuation set to ATTN_11DB (~0-3.3V) — wrapped in try/except for ESP8266/RP2040 compatibility
Only ADC1 channels (GPIO32-39) are reliable. ADC2 conflicts with Wi-Fi.
ADC is non-linear at extremes — values near 0 and 4095 may have larger error
Reading takes ~10μs — safe in tight loops
hardware_notes: Potentiometer: outer pins to 3.3V and GND, wiper (middle) to ADC pin
Add 100nF capacitor between ADC pin and GND for noise filtering
differences_from_standard_mp: Standard ADC returns 12-bit raw. Knob adds percent/value/value_int convenience properties.
